papers:

  # === Category 1: Reward Diversity / Reward Shaping for RL Stability ===

  - title: "GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization for Multi-reward RL Optimization"
    authors: NVIDIA Labs
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2026
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242
    category: reward_diversity
    role: closest_prior_work
    key_finding: >
      直接将 GRPO 应用于多 reward 组合时，不同 rollout 的 reward 组合在归一化后 collapse 为相同 advantage 值，
      降低训练信号分辨率导致收敛失败。GDPO 对每个 reward 独立做 group-wise normalization 再聚合，
      保留多 reward 的相对差异，显著提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最直接相关。CED reward 本质上引入了独立于 extraction F1 的 reward 维度（evidence quality），
      GDPO 的理论分析解释了为什么多维 reward 比单一 reward 更稳定——独立 reward 维度防止 advantage collapse。
      但 GDPO 是方法论贡献，CED 是 task-specific reward 设计自然具备了这一特性。

  - title: "DRA-GRPO: Exploring Diversity-Aware Reward Adjustment for R1-Zero-Like Training of LLMs"
    authors: Xiwen Chen et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.09655
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09655
    category: reward_diversity
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的标量 reward 无法区分语义多样但得分相同的输出（diversity-quality inconsistency）。
      DRA 用子模互信息（SMI）对 reward 加权，给多样性高的 completion 更大权重，
      等价于 Inverse Propensity Scoring 去偏，防止 policy 坍缩到先验模式。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DRA 通过后处理 reward 注入多样性信号；CED 的 reward 本身就内含对比结构自然提供 diversity 信号。
      机制互补但来源不同——CED 是 reward design 层面，DRA 是 optimization 层面。

  - title: "Shrinking the Variance: Shrinkage Baselines for RL with Verifiable Rewards"
    authors: Guanning Zeng et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2511.03710
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03710
    category: reward_diversity
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RLVR 中 per-prompt 均值 baseline 在低 generation 数下估计不准导致高 variance 梯度。
      用 James-Stein shrinkage 混合 per-prompt 和 cross-prompt 均值，
      构造可证明更低 variance 的 policy gradient estimator。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      理论支持：reward variance 对 gradient estimation 质量至关重要。
      CED 的额外 reward 维度提供更丰富的 per-group variance，间接起到 variance 维持效果。

  - title: "Reward Shaping to Mitigate Reward Hacking in RLHF"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2502.18770
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.18770
    category: reward_diversity
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      RL reward 应有界且先快速增长后缓慢收敛。系统研究 reward shaping 原则，
      好的 reward 形状能抑制 reward hacking 并提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED reward 的 0-1 对比判别结构天然满足有界性，
      且 evidence quality 的渐进提升符合"先快后慢"的 reward shaping 原则。

  # === Category 2: Mode Collapse Prevention in GRPO/RLHF ===

  - title: "DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale"
    authors: ByteDance Seed, Tsinghua AIR
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14476
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: key_baseline
    key_finding: >
      Naive GRPO 存在 entropy collapse（policy 熵快速下降→输出同质化）。
      根因：clipping 不对称性——概率 0.01 的 token 最多增到 0.012，而概率 0.9 的 token 可达 1.08，
      低概率 token 难以增长，抑制探索。DAPO 提出 Clip-Higher（εhigh=0.28 > εlow=0.2）
      为低概率 token 留更大增长空间，加 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0 或 1 的 prompt
      （这些 prompt 产生零梯度，降低有效 batch size）。在 AIME 2024 达 50 分超越 DeepSeek-R1-Zero。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DAPO 从 optimization 技巧角度解决 entropy collapse。CED reward 从 reward design 层面
      防止 mode collapse——evidence quality 维度确保 reward 组内有足够 variance，
      不会出现 all-same-reward 的零梯度 prompt。DAPO 的 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0/1 prompt
      与我们观察到的 frac_zero_std→0.8 现象本质相同：extraction-only reward 下大量 prompt
      产生零 advantage，CED 从源头（reward 设计）而非后处理（过滤）解决这个问题。

  - title: "Dr. GRPO: Removing Optimization Bias in GRPO"
    authors: Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: COLM 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20783
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 std 归一化引入两个 bias：(1) difficulty bias——std(r) 归一化对低 variance 组
      （全对/全错）给予过高 advantage 权重，trivial question 主导训练信号；
      (2) length bias——per-token loss 的 1/|o_i| 项使长的错误回答被 under-penalize。
      当 std(r)→0 时 advantage 爆炸或未定义，梯度数值不稳定。
      Dr. GRPO 移除 std 归一化，用无偏 Monte Carlo advantage：Ã = R(q,o_i) - mean(R)。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      与我们的实验发现高度一致：extraction-only reward 下 frac_zero_std→0.8 正是
      Dr. GRPO 分析的 difficulty bias 极端情况——大量 prompt 的所有 rollout 得到相同 F1，
      std→0 导致 advantage 异常。CED 通过增加 reward 维度天然维持 reward_std>0，
      从 reward 设计而非算法修改角度避免了 Dr. GRPO 发现的 bias。

  - title: "GVPO: Group Variance Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.19599
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: alternative_framework
    key_finding: >
      将 KL 约束 reward 最大化的解析解直接嵌入梯度权重，
      variance 项自然平衡 exploration 与 exploitation，维持适度 entropy。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      GVPO 的 variance 项机制与 CED 维持 reward variance 的效果功能类似，
      但 GVPO 是算法层面 implicit regularization，CED 是 reward 层面 explicit structure。

  - title: "REINFORCE++: Stabilizing Critic-Free Policy Optimization with Global Advantage Normalization"
    authors: Jian Hu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2501.03262
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03262
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      Prompt-level (local) advantage normalization 导致不准确估计和过拟合。
      Global batch normalization 提供更稳定、理论无偏的 gradient estimator。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      解决 local normalization 的 variance 问题；CED 从 reward 端增加 variance 来源。
      两者在不同层面解决同一问题：防止 gradient signal 消失。

  - title: "DiverseGRPO: Mitigating Mode Collapse in Image Generation via Diversity-Aware GRPO"
    authors: Henglin Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2512.21514
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.21514
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: parallel_work
    key_finding: >
      图像生成中 GRPO 后期输出同质化。distributional reward modeling（谱聚类+exploratory reward）
      和 structure-aware regularization 实现 13-18% 语义多样性提升。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      跨域验证了 GRPO mode collapse 的普遍性，distributional reward 思路与 CED 精神相近——
      都是通过 reward 层面结构化信号维持输出多样性。

  - title: "Why GRPO Needs Normalization: A Local-Curvature Perspective on Adaptive Gradients"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2601.23135
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.23135
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 reward_std 归一化在温和条件下提供严格优于未归一化 REINFORCE 的收敛速率，
      收益由 prompt 间平均 reward std 刻画。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      直接理论支撑：reward_std 越大收敛越好。CED 通过 evidence quality 维度维持高 reward_std，
      从该理论看 CED 的稳定性优势是 reward_std 维持带来的收敛速率优势。

  # === Category 3: Contrastive Rewards in RL ===

  - title: "Improving Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback Using Contrastive Rewards"
    authors: Shen, Zhang et al.
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv 2403.07708
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.07708
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: closest_contrastive_precedent
    key_finding: >
      两步机制：(1) 离线采样 baseline response；(2) 用 baseline 计算 contrastive reward
      作为 PPO 的 penalty 项。效果：惩罚 reward uncertainty、根据任务难度自适应校准、
      减少 PPO 中的 variance。在 TL;DR 和 HH-RLHF 上持续优于标准 RLHF。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最接近的对比 reward 先例。关键差异：(1) 它是对 learned RM 输出的后处理对比，
      CED 是 reward function 本身就是对比判别（evidence vs. corrupted evidence）；
      (2) 它在 PPO 中验证，CED 在 GRPO 中验证；
      (3) 它是 domain-agnostic penalty，CED 是 task-specific faithfulness signal。
      stabilizing 机制相通但实现路径根本不同。

  - title: "Improving Discriminative Capability of Reward Models in RLHF Using Contrastive Learning"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: EMNLP 2024
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.852/
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      无监督对比损失训练 reward model 充分捕捉对比数据区分度，
      带来更稳定的 PPO 训练 return 和 reward。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      验证对比训练 reward model → 更稳定 RL 训练链条。CED 不是对比训练 reward model，
      而是 reward function 本身就是对比判别，但 stabilizing 机制相通。

  - title: "Contrastive Preference Learning: Learning from Human Feedback without RL"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: ICLR 2025
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=iX1RjVQODj
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      将 preference learning 重新表述为对比学习问题，无需显式 RL 即可从人类反馈中学习。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      对比框架在 preference alignment 中的通用性。CED 可被视为 task-specific contrastive preference signal。

  # === Category 4: Evidence-Based Rewards in IE/NLP ===

  - title: "Drift: Enhancing LLM Faithfulness in Rationale Generation"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: ACL 2025
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2025.acl-long.340.pdf
    category: evidence_reward
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      用 faithfulness reward 引导 LLM 生成更可靠的 rationale，提升 CoT 推理事实一致性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      Faithfulness reward 用于生成质量的先例。CED 中 evidence discrimination
      本质上也是 faithfulness 信号——判断证据是否忠实支持抽取结果。

  - title: "Fine-Grained NLI-Based Faithfulness Evaluation for Diverse Summarisation Tasks (INFUSE)"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: EACL 2024
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2024.eacl-long.102/
    category: evidence_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      变长前提+简化假设的细粒度 NLI faithfulness 评估，超越传统 NLI 在多任务摘要上的表现。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      NLI 作为 faithfulness 评估工具的进展。CED 中 NLI 组件用于判断 evidence 对 triple 的支持度。

  - title: "Enhancing Cross-Evidence Reasoning Graph for Document-Level Relation Extraction"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: PMC/Bioinformatics 2024
    url: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11232587/
    category: evidence_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      文档级关系抽取中用 cross-evidence reasoning graph 增强跨证据推理。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DocRE 中 evidence 的重要性。但用 evidence 作为模型输入特征，
      我们用 evidence quality 作为 RL reward 信号——定位根本不同。

  # === Category 5: Multi-Objective RL for Text Generation ===

  - title: "Confronting Reward Model Overoptimization with Constrained RLHF"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: OpenReview
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=gkfUvn0fLU
    category: multi_objective_rl
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      多组件 RM 的 overoptimization 研究。component RM 间的相关性显著影响 overoptimization 临界点，
      用 constrained MDP 防止超出适当边界。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED 引入了与 extraction F1 低相关的 reward component（evidence quality），
      根据该论文分析低相关多组件 reward 更不易 overoptimize，
      可能是 CED 稳定性的另一个理论解释角度。

  - title: "On-Policy RL with Optimal Reward Baseline"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.23585
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.23585
    category: multi_objective_rl
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      Optimal baseline 一致性地实现更高训练 reward 和更高 entropy，
      有效稳定训练并促进更多样的 policy exploration。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED reward 的多维特性可能起到类似 optimal baseline 效果——
      evidence quality 维度为 advantage estimation 提供更丰富的参照信号。

  # === Category 6: RSFT Methodology & Theory ===

  - title: "A Minimalist Approach to LLM Reasoning: from Rejection Sampling to Reinforce"
    authors: Xiao et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2504.11343
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.11343
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: key_theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RAFT（简单 rejection sampling baseline）在数学推理上与 GRPO/PPO 表现相当。
      消融实验表明 GRPO 的主要优势来自丢弃全错 prompt 而非 reward normalization。
      提出 Reinforce-Rej，在 RAFT 基础上过滤全对和全错 sample。
      关键洞察：GRPO 和 RAFT 的核心区别在于负样本处理——GRPO 混合正负样本训练，
      RAFT 只用正样本，但 RAFT 仍能达到相当性能，说明 rejection sampling 的简单性被低估了。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      直接支持我们的设计选择：(1) RSFT 在 DocRE 上成功而 GRPO 失败，
      与该论文发现一致——rejection sampling 的 offline 特性天然避免了 catastrophic forgetting；
      (2) GRPO 主要优势来自过滤全错 prompt，这与我们 RSFT 的 reward-based filtering 机制相同；
      (3) DocRE structured output 比 math reasoning 更难用 online RL 优化，
      强化了 offline RSFT 的合理性。

  - title: "Beyond Rejection Sampling: Trajectory Fusion for Scaling Mathematical Reasoning (TrajFusion)"
    authors: Jie Deng et al.
    year: 2026
    venue: arXiv 2602.04391
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04391
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: method_component
    key_finding: >
      传统 RSFT 只用正确轨迹，丢弃错误轨迹。TrajFusion 将错误和正确轨迹交替拼接，
      显式建模试错推理过程，在困难数学问题上显著超越标准 RFT。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      Future work 方向：可考虑在 DocRE RSFT 中融合失败样本的信息。
      但 DocRE 的结构化输出（JSON triple）不同于 math 的 chain-of-thought，
      融合方式需要重新设计。

  - title: "Rejection Sampling Based Fine Tuning Secretly Performs PPO"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2025
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=yQ2UivKlir
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      建立 RSFT 与 PPO 之间的理论联系：rejection sampling fine-tuning
      在特定条件下隐式执行 PPO with marginal KL constraints。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      为 RSFT 的有效性提供理论解释。我们的 RSFT 成功可被视为
      隐式执行了 constrained policy optimization，
      避免了显式 GRPO 在 structured output 上的不稳定性。

  # === Category 7: RL for Information Extraction ===

  - title: "R1-RE: Cross-Domain Relation Extraction with RLVR"
    authors: Runpeng Dai, Tong Zheng et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2507.04642
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.04642
    category: rl_for_ie
    role: direct_competitor
    key_finding: >
      首个将 RLVR（GRPO + verifiable reward）用于关系抽取的框架。
      将 RE 重构为推理任务，R1-RE-7B 在跨域 OOD 准确率约 70%，媲美 GPT-4o。
      Reward 设计：format reward (+1/-3) + metric reward (+2/-1.5)，先验证格式再加准确度。
      triplet extraction 用 F1-based reward（entity weight=1, triplet weight=3）。
      未报告 catastrophic forgetting——GRPO 训练后在 MATH-500/IFEval/GPQA 上性能不降反升，
      说明句子级 RE 的简单 reward 结构足以稳定 GRPO 训练。
    results:
      sem2010_in_domain: 91.8
      sem2010_ood: 66.5
      mdkg_in_domain: 88.1
      mdkg_ood: 65.8
    evidence_generation: false
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      最直接竞争者。关键差异与讨论：
      (1) R1-RE 是句子级 RE，GRPO 成功；我们是文档级 RE，GRPO 失败→RSFT 成功。
      句子级 RE 每个 sample 只有 1 个 triple（binary classification），reward variance 天然充足；

  - title: "Correctness is not Faithfulness in RAG Attributions"
    authors: Wallat, Heuss, de Rijke, Anand

    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.18004
    category: faithfulness_accuracy_tradeoff

      同时不牺牲 RE accuracy。
      Related Work 引用点：correctness-faithfulness 分离的概念框架。

  # === Category 13: Evidence-Grounded RL (NEW - 2026-05-15 scan) ===

  - title: "EvidenceRL: Reinforcing Evidence Consistency for Trustworthy Language Models"
    authors: Ben Tamo, Lu, Marteau, Nnamdi, Wang
    year: 2026
    venue: arXiv 2603.19532
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19532
    category: evidence_grounded_rl
    role: closest_competitor
    key_finding: >
      用 GRPO 同时优化 grounding（evidence entailment）和 correctness（答案准确性）。
      在 cardiac diagnosis（Llama-3.2-3B）上 F1@3 从 37.0→54.5，grounding 从 47.6→78.2，
      hallucination 降 5 倍。在 legal reasoning（Llama-3.1-8B）上 faithfulness 从 32.8%→67.6%。
      核心：证据一致性 reward 不牺牲 task accuracy 的前提下大幅提升 faithfulness。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      **最直接的 novelty 威胁。** EvidenceRL 与 FREIGE 共享核心 idea：用 GRPO + evidence faithfulness reward
      训练更可靠的模型。关键差异：(1) EvidenceRL 在 QA 域（cardiac/legal），不涉及 DocRE 的 structured output；
      (2) EvidenceRL 未报告 evidence generation 的 performance cost（evidence tax）——它的 grounding 和
      correctness 同时提升，而我们发现 DocRE 中两者存在 ~8pp 张力；
      (3) EvidenceRL 不涉及 task decoupling 现象（QLoRA-specific）；
      (4) EvidenceRL 无 inference-time reranking（CED reranker）。
      定位策略：EvidenceRL 证明 evidence-grounded RL 在 QA 域有效，
      我们揭示 DocRE structured output 带来的独特挑战（evidence tax、task decoupling）和解法（CED reranker）。

  # === Category 14: Multi-Objective GRPO (NEW - 2026-05-15 scan) ===

  - title: "MO-GRPO: Mitigating Reward Hacking of Group Relative Policy Optimization on Multi-Objective Problems"
    authors: Ichihara, Jinnai, Morimura, Sakamoto, Mitsuhashi, Uchibe
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2509.22047
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.22047
    category: multi_objective_grpo
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 在多目标设置下易发生 reward hacking——只优化一个目标而牺牲其他目标。

      在多臂赌博机、控制、机器翻译、指令遵从四个域上实现稳定学习。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      CED reward 本质是多目标（extraction F1 + evidence quality）。MO-GRPO 的分析
      解释了为什么单一 extraction F1 reward 下模型可能 hack 到 "忽略 evidence 只抽 triple" 的策略。
      CED 从 reward 设计端解决，MO-GRPO 从算法端解决，互补视角。

    authors: Bai, Liu, Zhuang, Zhou, Weng, Chen, Wang, Cai

      提出 EPPO（Energy loss-aware PPO）在 reward 计算中惩罚 energy loss 增加。
      EPPO 可解释为 entropy-regularized RL。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      与 FREIGE Claim 4（EDCR 双层诊断工具）直接相关：energy loss 是另一种 representation-level
      diagnostic for reward hacking。EDCR 从 evidence-relation consistency 角度诊断，
      EPPO 从 hidden state energy 角度诊断——互补的诊断信号。
      FREIGE 可引用 EPPO 作为 "diagnostic signals for RL training health" 的同类工作。

    authors: Unknown
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2509.15557
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.15557
    category: reward_hacking_diagnostics

      composite reward function 结合 correctness incentives + 结构性 penalties 缓解 hacking。
      二值 reward（非连续）更稳定——连续 reward 的 smooth gradients 被 exploit。
      augmenting verifiable outcome rewards with explicit penalties 将 hacking 从 0.23-0.60 降至 ≤0.06。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      与 FREIGE 的 evidence reward design 直接相关：FREIGE 的 extraction-only hack

      composite reward 的 explicit penalty 思路验证了 CED reward 设计的合理性。

    authors: Zhaopeng Qiu, Shuang Yu, Jingqi Zhang, Shuai Zhang, Xue Huang, Jingyi Yang, Junjie Lai
    year: 2026
    venue: arXiv 2601.18150
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.18150
    category: quantization_rl_stability
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      FP8 RL 训练中 policy weights 每步变化需重复量化同步，低精度 rollout 偏离高精度 policy
      导致 train-inference mismatch 和训练不稳定。MoE 架构中精度差异导致 expert routing 不一致，
      routing inconsistencies 随训练累积使 mismatch KL 逐渐增大。
      通过 importance-sampling-based rollout correction 缓解，实现 44% rollout 加速。

      FP8-RL 揭示的 train-inference precision mismatch 机制直接映射到 FREIGE 的 QLoRA GRPO 场景：
      QLoRA 中 4-bit base + bf16 LoRA 的精度不对称与 FP8-RL 中 FP8 rollout + bf16 train 的模式相同。
      两者都导致 policy divergence 随训练累积——这是 evidence-extraction decoupling 的底层机制之一。

      根因是 off-policy 性质引入的训练-推理数值 mismatch。统一 FP8 精度消除此差异，
      实现 41% training 加速和 16% 端到端加速，同时维持稳定收敛。

      Jet-RL 的 "catastrophic accuracy collapse" 与 FREIGE 中 QLoRA GRPO 的 evidence 生成退化高度类似：

    year: 2025
    venue: Findings of EACL 2026
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.19178
    category: multi_task_rl_gradient_imbalance
    role: closest_prior_work
    key_finding: >
      多任务 RL post-training 中某些任务产生显著更大的梯度，偏置更新方向。
      大梯度任务不一定获得更大学习收益——gradient magnitude 与 performance improvement 不相关。
      常见训练统计量（reward, advantage, token length）无法解释此不平衡，
      暗示不平衡源于 inherent task differences。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      最直接相关 C2 和 C3。FREIGE 中 RE 和 evidence extraction 在 GRPO 训练中的 gradient imbalance
      正是此论文描述的现象：extraction 任务可能产生主导梯度，压制 evidence generation 的学习——
      这是 task decoupling 的 gradient-level 解释。该论文呼吁 "principled gradient-level corrections"，

    authors: Chujie Zheng et al. (Alibaba Qwen Team)
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2512.01374
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.01374
    category: quantization_rl_stability
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      通过一阶近似证明 sequence-level reward 可用 surrogate token-level objective 优化，
      但前提是 training-inference discrepancy 和 policy staleness 最小化。
      Token-level importance sampling 是校正 train-inference 差异的必要组件——移除后训练崩溃。
      30B MoE 模型上数十万 GPU 小时的实验验证。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      理论支持 FREIGE C2：QLoRA 的量化引入的 training-inference discrepancy 违反了
      token-level surrogate 有效的前提条件，导致 GRPO 训练不稳定。

      faithfulness decay 现象说明模型内部表征和外部输出之间存在系统性偏差，

    year: 2025

    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03200

      即使最强 LLM 在 grounding 任务上也远未完美（~12% failure rate），
      这证明 evidence-grounded IE 中 faithfulness 约束确实会带来 performance cost (C1)。

I found several relevant research findings on chain-of-thought extraction and accuracy trade-offs in information extraction. Here are the key findings:

## Trade-off Between Coverage and Accuracy

Research on latent reasoning chain extraction shows a trade-off between entity coverage and reasoning edge accuracy: models that achieve higher entity coverage often do so at the cost of lower reasoning edge accuracy, and vice versa. Two logic-aware evaluation metrics were proposed: Entity Coverage (EC) for content completeness and Reasoning Edge Accuracy (REA) for step-by-step logical validity.

## Chain-of-Thought for Retrieval and Extraction

The main tension in rationale-guided retrieval is between accuracy and computational cost, as generating reasoning traces at query time adds latency and compute overhead. However, systems using rationale guidance typically show 15-30% improvement in answer accuracy on multi-hop questions compared to standard dense retrieval, particularly on queries requiring three or more reasoning steps.

## Computational Efficiency Trade-off

Research on invoice information extraction underscores a trade-off between semantic accuracy and computational efficiency. Chain-of-thought approaches offer the highest accuracy but also the highest latency through multiple retrieval and generation rounds.

## Performance Limitations

Evaluations on state-of-the-art language models reveal that even the best models struggle to exceed 50% accuracy in recognizing and properly formalizing latent reasoning chains via standard paradigms.

I found relevant research on your topic. Here are the key findings from the search results:

## Performance Degradation Trade-offs in NLP

There exists a trade-off between structural compliance and task accuracy, as demonstrated when models generate incorrect answers when forced to comply with a structured JSON format, despite producing correct answers in unconstrained generation.

## Multi-task Performance Degradation

Multi-task processing shows predictable trade-offs in specialized semantic processing capabilities, though models can maintain moderate-to-high performance across diverse NLP tasks concurrently. However, there is no universal degradation rule, and multitask prompting resilience appears to be shaped more by architectural design than by model size alone, motivating adaptive, model-specific strategies.

## Reasoning and Task Performance

An important finding concerns explicit reasoning methods: explicit reasoning through Chain-of-Thought prompting can negatively impact the instruction-following abilities of large language models, with consistent performance degradation demonstrated across comprehensive benchmarks. While reasoning is intended to improve task performance, it can unintentionally shift model focus away from critical constraints and harm instruction adherence.

## Efficiency vs. Performance Trade-off

Generating three thoughts per stage yields the best trade-off between performance and efficiency, while the Knowledge Propagation Module consistently reduces reasoning variance by leveraging both accepted and discarded thoughts.

These findings highlight several important trade-offs in NLP task performance, particularly around reasoning generation, structural constraints, and multi-task scenarios.

## Evidence Extraction and Performance-Cost Trade-offs

In retrieval-augmented systems, the computational cost of evidence is measured by the average length of extracted evidence fed into generators, where smaller values indicate lower computational cost.

## Relation Extraction Performance Trade-offs

Several important findings emerge regarding different approaches to relation extraction:

**Pipeline vs. Generative Models**: Well-designed pipeline models offer substantial performance gains at a lower cost and carbon footprint for end-to-end relation extraction, while GPT models with significantly more parameters perform worse than sequence-to-sequence models and lose to pipeline models by over 10 F1 points.

**Multi-step Reasoning Trade-off**: Breaking down the relation extraction task into multiple subtasks provides visual evidence and simplifies the task; however, the multi-step reasoning process can increase the model's complexity, particularly for simple problems.

**Data Generation Approaches**: Integrating the generative capabilities of large language models with the extractive capabilities of smaller models optimizes the latter using generated data and leverages the strengths of each model; however, this approach faces challenges with the quality of generated data and incurs relatively higher training costs.

**Prompt-Based Methods**: Prompt-based relation extraction approaches that only require adjustments to prompt parameters, such as the number of provided examples, significantly reduce the model's training cost.

Based on the web search results, here's what I found about the "cost of faithfulness" in relation to information extraction and explanation generation:

## Key Findings

**Robustness-Faithfulness Trade-off:**
Research shows there exists a robustness-faithfulness trade-off, where improving robustness of explanations can come at the cost of faithfulness. As explanations become more robust, their faithfulness can decrease.

**Faithfulness in Model Explanations:**
Faithfulness is defined as an explanation that should accurately represent the reasoning process behind the model's prediction. This is particularly important in NLP where over 110 model explanation methods have been reviewed through the lens of faithfulness.

**Information Extraction Context:**
Research has assessed ChatGPT's ability across fine-grained information extraction tasks by measuring performance, explainability, calibration, and faithfulness. While ChatGPT provides high-quality explanations, there is an issue of being overconfident in predictions, resulting in low calibration.

**Explanation Generation Methods:**
Explanation methods in pursuit of faithfulness are grouped into five categories: similarity-based methods, analysis of model-internal structures, backpropagation-based methods, counterfactual intervention, and self-explanatory models.

The search results highlight that achieving faithful explanations in information extraction tasks involves navigating trade-offs between competing objectives like robustness and accuracy.

Based on the web search results, here's what I found regarding "faithful information extraction" cost overhead evidence and rationale:

## Faithfulness in Information Extraction

Assessing the faithfulness of models to the original text is crucial in developing trustworthy information extraction systems, specifically referring to whether explanations provided align with the original text when predictions are correct.

## Cost-Benefit Evidence

Research demonstrates that faithful extraction methods can provide significant advantages despite potential overhead costs. One approach achieved an extremely high compression ratio (e.g., 38.1x with a 1.5B size model), while maintaining performance very close to or even surpassing full-text baselines. In contrast, although competitive baselines have relatively high compression ratios, their compression is often accompanied by large performance degradation.

## Quality and Rationale

Case studies show that rational evidence benefits systems through reduction of redundant context, refusal when evidence is insufficient, robustness to noise, and early stopping once evidence is enough. 

Additionally, models can be trained to optimize reward functions that reflect extraction accuracy while penalizing extra effort, suggesting that the overhead costs of faithful extraction are balanced against accuracy improvements and efficiency gains.

Based on the search results, here are the key findings regarding explanation generation, performance degradation, and NLP classification/extraction:

## Performance Degradation in Multi-Task NLP Systems

Performance degradation is not uniform across all tasks, with highly structured generative tasks like JSON formatting exhibiting relative stability, while classification tasks, particularly Emotion Classification and Topic Extraction, are highly susceptible to significant performance drops as models progress through task sequences.

The introduction of named entity recognition (NER) created the most significant disruption, particularly affecting emotion classification performance, suggesting that entity extraction requires specialized attention mechanisms that compete directly with emotion processing resources.

## Explanation Generation for Classification

Research demonstrates that approaches can significantly enhance the quality of model explanations without causing substantial (sometimes negligible) degradation in the original model's performance. Distilled models can deliver explanations of the same quality as larger models while surpassing them in classification performance.

## Monitoring Performance Degradation

For maintaining text classification systems, it's important to regularly track key metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score to detect any degradation in performance. NLP model performance will degrade over time if not proactively monitored for and corrected data drift.

## Explainability for NLP Models

Getting token-level explanations of model output is incredibly useful and important for understanding why a model might be getting something wrong, whether using bag-of-words models or sequence-based models.

I found research directly addressing your query. Here are the key findings:

## The Core Trade-off

An inherent trade-off exists between model performance and explanation plausibility. While saliency post-hoc explainability methods can reflect model reasoning, they may not align with human intuition, making explanations not plausible.

## Methodology Using Human Rationales

A methodology incorporates rationales, which are text annotations explaining human decisions, into text classification models, enhancing the plausibility of post-hoc explanations while preserving their faithfulness.

The approach introduces rationales during model training by augmenting standard cross-entropy loss with a novel loss function inspired by contrastive learning, then leverages a multi-objective optimization algorithm to explore the trade-off and generate a Pareto-optimal frontier of models balancing performance and plausibility.

## Key Results

The approach significantly enhances the quality of model explanations without causing substantial (sometimes negligible) degradation in the original model's performance.

The research paper was published in the Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: NAACL 2024 by Lucas E. Resck, Marcos M. Raimundo, and Jorge Poco.

## Key Finding

A desideratum for rationale extraction is that it should not hurt task performance. This represents a recognized challenge in the field—maintaining performance on the main task while also generating rationales for explainability.

Based on the search results, here's what I found about document-level relation extraction with evidence sentence supporting evidence and joint extraction:

## Overview

Document-level relation extraction is a challenging task which requires reasoning over multiple sentences in order to predict relations in a document.

## Joint Extraction Approaches

One prominent framework in this area is the **E2GRE model**. E2GRE (Entity and Evidence Guided Relation Extraction) is a novel framework that jointly extracts relations and the underlying evidence sentences by using large pretrained language model (LM) as input encoder. 

The E2GRE approach works through several mechanisms:
- Instead of feeding the whole document into pretrained LMs to obtain entity representation, entity-guided approaches concatenate document text with head entities to help LMs concentrate on parts of the document that are more related to the head entity.
- The approach guides the pretrained LM's attention mechanism to focus on relevant context by using attention probabilities as additional features for evidence prediction.

## Evidence Requirements

Research shows that over 95% of entity pairs require no more than 3 sentences as supporting evidence. Models combine the evidence information with original data to jointly extract relations.

## Related Approaches

Some approaches introduce extra neural networks that jointly learn relation extraction and evidence prediction. Additionally, models can be jointly trained on RE and evidence extraction during training, while during inference, prediction results on both the original document and the extracted evidence are combined, which encourages the model to focus on the important sentences while reducing information loss.

Based on the search results, I found comprehensive information about the topics you're interested in:

## DocRE, Evidence, and Key Methods

Document-level relation extraction (DocRE) is the task of identifying all relations between each entity pair in a document, and evidence, defined as sentences containing clues for the relationship between an entity pair, has been shown to help DocRE systems focus on relevant texts, thus improving relation extraction.

## ATLOP

ATLOP computes a localized context embedding based on attention weights from the Transformer-based encoder, with the rationale that cross-token dependencies are encoded as attention weights in Transformer layers.

## DREEAM

DREEAM enhances ATLOP with evidence. In addition to the automatically-learned cross-token dependencies, the attention modules are supervised to concentrate more on evidence sentences and less on others.

More specifically, DREEAM is a memory-efficient approach that adopts evidence information as the supervisory signal, thereby guiding the attention modules of the DocRE system to assign high weights to evidence, and proposes a self-training strategy for DREEAM to learn evidence retrieval from automatically-generated evidence on massive data without evidence annotations.

The experimental results reveal that DREEAM improves over the state-of-the-art supervised approaches by approximately 2.0 points on Evidence F1.

Based on the web search results, I found relevant information about self-explaining models, their performance costs, task accuracy, and joint training approaches in NLP. Here are the key findings:

## Self-Explaining Models and Performance Trade-offs

Local self-explaining methods are defined as simultaneously explaining and predicting, which is distinct from post-hoc explanation approaches. 

An important consideration is that attention mechanism usage can contribute to a tradeoff between noisy rationales and a decrease in prediction accuracy. This suggests that generating explanations alongside predictions may impose computational or accuracy costs.

## Joint Training and Rationale Generation

Seq2seq (Sequence to Sequence) models work well at generating explanations and predictions together, however, these models require a large-labeled dataset for training and bring a host of challenges such as fabricating explanations for incorrect predictions, the difficulty of adapting to long input documents, etc.

For improving performance, joint predict-explain methods have been investigated, and explanations can improve downstream prediction accuracy and perform as a data augmentation technique.

## Frameworks for Rationalization

The Fid-Ex framework includes sentence markers to encourage extractive explanations and intermediate fine-tuning for improving few-shot performance on open-domain QA datasets, and this framework significantly improves upon prior work on the explanation metrics and task accuracy on supervised and few-shot settings.

## Multi-Task Learning Benefits

Joint training refers to the simultaneous optimization of a model on various tasks, and recent studies suggest that utilizing grouped tasks can boost overall accuracy, with models that tackle language understanding and sentiment analysis simultaneously often surpassing those focused on a single task.

I found the paper! Here's information about "Robust Explanation for Free or At the Cost of Faithfulness" by Tan et al., ICML 2023:

## Overview

This paper investigates explanation methods for machine learning models' trustworthiness, addresses their vulnerability to adversarial perturbations, and examines when robust explanations are necessary and what they cost.

## Key Findings

The paper proves that the robustness of explanations is determined by the robustness of the model to be explained, meaning robust explanations can be obtained for free for a robust model.

To have robust explanations for a non-robust model, composing the original model with a kernel is proven as an effective way that returns strictly more robust explanations. However, this incurs a robustness-faithfulness trade-off, where an explanation method may also become less faithful when it becomes more robust.

The paper is the first to introduce this trade-off and theoretically proves its existence for SmoothGrad, with theoretical findings verified by empirical evidence on six state-of-the-art explanation methods and four backbones.

## Methods Evaluated

The robustness and faithfulness of explanations are evaluated for Gradient, Gradient×Input, SmoothGrad, Integrated Gradient, LIME, and SHAP.

The paper is available at the ICML 2023 proceedings: https://proceedings.mlr.press/v202/tan23a/tan23a.pdf

Based on the search results, here's what recent research shows about the pitfalls of chain-of-thought reasoning and how it can hurt LLM performance:

## Key Findings on CoT Performance Degradation

Chain-of-thought can drastically harm LLM performance in cases where overthinking hurts human performance and humans and models face similar constraints when performing the task. Researchers have identified specific scenarios where explicit reasoning causes performance to decline.

## Specific Mechanisms of Failure

**Overthinking and Pattern Recognition**: When humans are given opportunities to deliberate after receiving feedback, they learn more slowly and make more errors compared to those who do not deliberate, as active thought mentally ingrains incorrect patterns that shift when exposed to successive unexpected answers.

**Verbosity and Explanation Overfitting**: When prompted for chain-of-thought, models often produce longer explanations than the task requires, and this verbosity introduces new failure surfaces. Additionally, models trained or evaluated heavily with CoT prompts may overfit to explanation formats rather than task structure.

**Error Accumulation**: While early-stage decomposition helps break down the problem, excessively long reasoning paths lead to error accumulation—where a single mistake can mislead the entire chain of thought.

## Instruction Following Issues

Research shows that LLMs' ability to follow instructions is not robust enough, as even instructions with identical semantics and fluent expressions could lead models to plummet from high performance levels to far below average.

## Practical Implications

Chain-of-Thought prompting is not universally optimal, with effectiveness depending significantly on model type and specific use case—for non-reasoning models, CoT may improve average performance but can introduce inconsistency, while for reasoning models, the minimal accuracy gains rarely justify the increased response time.

Based on the search results, here's what I found about the "Mind Your Step (by Step)" research paper:

## Overview

"Mind Your Step (by Step): Chain-of-Thought can Reduce Performance on Tasks where Thinking Makes Humans Worse" is a research paper that examines when chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting systematically reduces large language model performance.

## Key Findings

The researchers identified the characteristics of tasks where CoT reduces performance by drawing inspiration from cognitive psychology, focusing on six representative tasks from the psychological literature where deliberation hurts performance in humans.

In three of these tasks, state-of-the-art models exhibit significant performance drop-offs with CoT (up to 36.3% absolute accuracy for OpenAI o1-preview compared to GPT-4o), while in others, CoT effects are mixed, with positive, neutral, and negative changes.

## Task Categories Affected

Three specific cases where CoT reduces performance are implicit statistical learning, visual recognition, and classifying with patterns containing exceptions.

## The Approach

The researchers explored the heuristic that tasks for which thinking or deliberation decrease human performance can also be ones for which CoT harms model performance.

## Publication Status

The paper was first submitted on October 27, 2024, with subsequent versions released through November 2024 and June 2025.

Based on the search results, here is what I found about DREEAM and evidence prediction with relation F1 improvements in DocRED:

## Overview of DREEAM

DREEAM is a memory-efficient approach that adopts evidence information as the supervisory signal, thereby guiding the attention modules of the DocRE system to assign high weights to evidence. Evidence, defined as sentences containing clues for the relationship between an entity pair, has been shown to help DocRE systems focus on relevant texts, thus improving relation extraction.

## Key Approach

The method proposes a memory-efficient approach that adopts evidence information as the supervisory signal to guide the attention modules, and proposes a self-training strategy for DREEAM to learn evidence retrieval from automatically-generated evidence on massive data without evidence annotations.

## Performance Improvements

Experimental results reveal that the approach exhibits state-of-the-art performance on the DocRED benchmark for both document-level relation extraction and evidence retrieval. More specifically, DREEAM improves over the state-of-the-art supervised approaches by approximately 2.0 points on Evi F1 (evidence F1 score).

## Key Advantages

Evidence retrieval in DocRE faces two major issues: high memory consumption and limited availability of annotations, and this work aims at addressing these issues to improve the usage of evidence retrieval in DocRE.

The paper was published at EACL 2023 and represents a significant advance in incorporating evidence-guided supervision into document-level relation extraction systems.

Based on the search results, I found relevant information about joint approaches in relation extraction and the challenges they face:

## Key Findings on Joint Evidence and Relation Extraction

**Multi-Task Learning Trade-offs:**

Multi-task learning provides significant improvements for relation extraction on some datasets like ChemProt and I2B2-2010, but it results in decreased performance when applied to the DDI-2013 dataset, with knowledge distillation also failing to outperform single-task performance on that dataset. This phenomenon is referred to as negative transfer.

**Joint Training Benefits:**

In contrast, joint training for classification and explainability helps the classification task itself, or in the worst case, does not hurt relation classification, yielding a statistically significant improvement of nearly 4% F1 on CoNLL04.

**Feature Conflict Challenges:**

Joint entity and relation extraction methods that integrate tasks by sharing the encoding layer face challenges due to incongruities in the contextual information captured by these subtasks, resulting in potential feature conflicts and adverse effects on model performance.

**Comparison of Approaches:**

Joint relation extraction approaches tend to be less susceptible to error propagation because this holistic training approach allows the model to learn optimal representations for both tasks concurrently, minimizing the impact of errors in one aspect on the other.

The search results highlight that while joint approaches can provide benefits for relation extraction, performance outcomes are dataset-dependent and can involve trade-offs between different objectives.

The search results reveal relevant findings on related topics, particularly from recent research on SFT and fine-tuning trade-offs:

**Key Finding on Performance Trade-offs:**

SFT's primary function is to specialize a model for in-distribution (ID) tasks, but prolonged training degrades out-of-distribution (OOD) performance. Reinforcement learning (RL) then serves as a crucial corrective step by recovering the OOD generalization lost during SFT.

This highlights a fundamental trade-off, where RL re-balances the model, restoring robust generalization at the cost of a slight reduction in its highly specialized ID accuracy.

Additionally, the stronger the SFT checkpoint is, the more faithfully the OOD ability can be rescued by RL.

**Dataset Quality and Challenges:**

The results of SFT are heavily dependent upon the dataset that is curated. If the dataset contains a diverse set of examples that accurately capture all relevant alignment criteria and characterize the language model's expected output, then SFT is a great approach.

The search results provide general information on SFT and fine-tuning performance penalties, though a more specialized search focusing specifically on "generative information extraction" with "evidence" and "faithfulness" constraints might yield more targeted research papers on this specific combination of topics.

## E2GRE: Entity and Evidence Guided Relation Extraction for DocRED

E2GRE (Entity and Evidence Guided Relation Extraction) is a joint training framework proposed for document-level relation extraction. The approach addresses the challenge of extracting relations from documents by reasoning over multiple sentences.

### Key Components

The framework introduces entity-guided sequences as inputs to a pre-trained language model (e.g., BERT, RoBERTa), which help the language model focus on areas of the document related to the entity.

Secondly, the approach guides the fine-tuning of the pre-trained language model by using its internal attention probabilities as additional features for evidence prediction, encouraging the model to focus on the entities and supporting/evidence sentences.

### Evaluation and Results

The E2GRE approach was evaluated on DocRED, a large-scale dataset for relation extraction. The approach is able to achieve state-of-the-art results on the public leaderboard across all metrics, showing that E2GRE is both effective and synergistic on relation extraction and evidence prediction.

E2GRE jointly learns relation extraction and evidence prediction effectively, showing large gains on both these tasks, which are highly correlated.

The paper was published on arXiv in August 2020 by Kevin Huang and colleagues.

## Paper Overview

This paper was authored by Zheng Tang and Mihai Surdeanu and published in Computational Linguistics, Volume 49, Issue 1 (2023).

## Main Contribution

The paper proposes an explainable approach for relation extraction that mitigates the tension between generalization and explainability by jointly training for the two goals.

## Methodology

The approach uses a multi-task learning architecture, which jointly trains a classifier for relation extraction, and a sequence model that labels words in the context of the relations that explain the decisions of the relation classifier. The model outputs are also converted to rules to bring global explanations to this approach.

The sequence model is trained using a hybrid strategy: supervised, when supervision from pre-existing patterns is available, and semi-supervised otherwise. In the semi-supervised case, the sequence model's labels are treated as latent variables, and the best assignment is learned that maximizes the performance of the relation classifier.

## Key Innovation

The relation classifier operates directly on top of the words deemed important for the relation by the explainability classifier, which guarantees that explanations are faithful—correctly depicting how the relation classifier makes a decision.

Based on the search results, here's what I found about CDER:

## Overview

Document-level Relation Extraction (DocRE) involves identifying relations between entities across multiple sentences in a document, with evidence sentences being crucial for precise entity pair relationships identification.

## The CDER Framework

CDER is a novel evidence retrieval framework that employs an attentional graph-based architecture to capture collaborative patterns and incorporates a dynamic sub-structure for additional robustness in evidence retrieval.

Existing evidence retrieval systems often overlook the collaborative nature among semantically similar entity pairs in the same document, hindering the effectiveness of the evidence retrieval task.

## Technical Details

CDER transforms the document into a bipartite graph with entity pair and sentence nodes, partitioning it into three sub-graphs: (i) Entity Pair sub-graph models collaboration, (ii) Entity Pair-Sentence sub-graph captures semantic relationships, and (iii) Sentence sub-graph aids co-reference reasoning.

To address noisy information, the framework introduces Entity Pair-aware Graph Attention Networks (GATs), tailored to the framework.

## Results

Experimental results on the benchmark DocRE dataset show that CDER not only excels in the evidence retrieval task but also enhances overall performance of existing DocRE system.

The paper was published on arXiv in April 2025 and is authored by Khai Phan Tran and Xue Li.

Based on the search results, here's what I found about "thinking hurts" and the reasoning tax in LLM performance:

## The Core Problem: "Thinking Hurts" on Simple Tasks

On simple tasks, thinking hurts—for example, factual recall accuracy drops by 2.4-3.8% because the model wastes tokens overthinking questions like 'What's the capital of France?' Translation and classification tasks see no benefit, as these are pattern-matching, not reasoning tasks—the model shouldn't think about them.

## The Reasoning Tax: Computational Overhead and Cost

While long chain-of-thought reasoning significantly boosts accuracy, step-by-step thinking mechanisms also lead to lengthy output responses, resulting in substantial computational overhead and increased reasoning time.

Reasoning LLMs think step-by-step using chain-of-thought, tools, and planner-executor-verifier loops to solve harder problems with higher accuracy, but at the cost of latency, tokens, and dollars.

## The "Overthinking Phenomenon"

An example of the "overthinking phenomenon" occurs when reasoning models take unnecessarily long times (e.g., 19 seconds for QwQ-32B and 42 seconds for DeepSeek-R1, tested in March 2025) to arrive at the correct answer to simple comparisons like "Which is larger, 0.9 or 0.11?"

## Market Growth and Task-Specific Application

The test-time scaling segment grew from $187 million in early 2024 to $432 million by mid-2025. However, use thinking tokens when the problem has steps, and avoid them when the answer is a fact.

The research shows that reasoning is a valuable but selective tool—beneficial for complex multi-step problems, but wasteful for factual retrieval or simple pattern-matching tasks.

## AutoRE: Document-Level Relation Extraction with Large Language Models

AutoRE is an end-to-end DocRE model that adopts a novel RE extraction paradigm named RHF (Relation-Head-Facts), addressing limitations in document-level relation extraction.

### Problem It Solves

Most existing methods are predominantly designed for Sentence-level Relation Extraction (SentRE) tasks, which typically encompass a restricted set of relations and triplet facts within a single sentence. Furthermore, certain approaches resort to treating relations as candidate choices integrated into prompt templates, leading to inefficient processing and suboptimal performance when tackling Document-Level Relation Extraction (DocRE) tasks.

### Technical Approach

The AutoRE system introduces an RHF (Relation–Head–Facts) paradigm, leveraging LLMs with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (QLoRA). The extraction is decomposed into three modular steps—relation detection, head entity identification, and tail entity/fact prediction—each realized as a distinct fine-tuned LLM module.

### Key Advantage

AutoRE adopts a novel RE extraction paradigm named RHF (Relation-Head-Facts), which does not rely on the assumption of known relation options, making it more reflective of real-world scenarios.

### Performance

The AutoRE system demonstrates that off-the-shelf LLMs fine-tuned via QLoRA adapters on modular RHF subtasks can achieve state-of-the-art results, significantly exceeding strong baselines.

The paper was published in 2024 at the ACL (Association for Computational Linguistics) conference.

## Chain of Thought with Explicit Evidence Reasoning (CoT-ER) for Few-shot Relation Extraction

CoT-ER is a novel approach for few-shot relation extraction using large language models, standing for "chain-of-thought with explicit evidence reasoning."

### Key Approach

CoT-ER first induces large language models to generate evidences using task-specific and concept-level knowledge, then these evidences are explicitly incorporated into chain-of-thought prompting for relation extraction. The approach addresses a gap where evidence for inference is either not considered or implicitly modeled during the construction of chain-of-thought prompts.

### Framework Components

The approach includes a human-instructed reasoning module that associates an evidence reasoning process with each instance from the support set by prompting LLM with human-annotated demonstrations, and an instances retrieval module that selects the few-shot demonstrations from the candidate set based on their similarity to the query instance.

### Performance

Experimental results demonstrate that CoT-ER (with 0% training data) achieves competitive performance compared to fully-supervised state-of-the-art approaches (with 100% training data) on the FewRel1.0 and FewRel2.0 datasets.

### Publication

The paper was published in the Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2023.

I found a comprehensive 2023 survey on rationalization for explainable NLP. Here are the key findings from the search results:

## Overview

Rationalization is an emerging explainable technique for NLP applications that provides explanations in natural language to justify a model's prediction, presenting the input features influencing the model's prediction.

## Key Concepts

Rationalization can be divided into two major groups: abstractive and extractive, where extractive rationalization extracts important features or sentences from the input data as rationales to support the prediction, while abstractive rationalization is a generative task in which novel sentences are generated using new words or paraphrasing existing sentences.

## Task Performance vs. Explainability Trade-off

Rationalization in NLP was first introduced in 2007, with the objective to use annotator rationales to improve task performance for text categorization, though explainability was not the core objective. However, explainability is an advantage of rationalization because it makes the model inherently explainable even if used in the context of task improvement.

Results indicated improvement in the quality of extractive rationales that bridges the gap between task performance and explainability.

## Survey Details

This is the first literature to survey the field of rationalization in NLP and introduces a new subfield called Rational AI (RAI) within Explainable AI (XAI).

I found the paper you were looking for! Here are the key details about the paper:

## Publication Information

The paper "Revisiting Relation Extraction in the era of Large Language Models" was authored by Somin Wadhwa, Silvio Amir, and Byron Wallace, and was published in 2023 at the 61st Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL).

## Research Focus

The research pushed the limits of sequence-to-sequence approaches using larger language models (GPT-3 and Flan-T5 large) than considered in prior work and evaluated their performance on standard RE tasks under varying levels of supervision.

## Key Findings

The researchers addressed issues inherent to evaluating generative approaches to RE by doing human evaluations, in lieu of relying on exact matching, and found that few-shot prompting with GPT-3 achieves near SOTA (state-of-the-art) performance.

The paper is available through the ACL Anthology and has also been posted on arXiv (abs/2305.05003).

Based on the search results, here's what I found about GLiDRE:

## Overview

GLiDRE is a new compact model for document-level relation extraction, designed to work efficiently in both supervised and few-shot settings. It was introduced by Robin Armingaud and Romaric Besançon in 2025.

## Key Characteristics

GLiDRE uses a dual-encoder structure: a text encoder generates token embeddings, while a label encoder computes embeddings for relation types. An entity representation is formed by pooling the embeddings of its constituent tokens and mentions. For each entity pair, their representations are concatenated and processed by a feed-forward network before final scoring.

## Performance

Experiments in both low-resource supervised training and few-shot meta-learning benchmarks show that the approach outperforms existing methods in data-constrained scenarios, establishing a new state-of-the-art in few-shot document-level relation extraction.

## Design Inspiration

The GLiNER model has shown that a compact NER model can outperform much larger Large Language Models. With a similar motivation, GLiDRE is a new model for document-level relation extraction that builds on the key ideas of GLiNER.

## Availability

The project is available on GitHub with development having moved to a dedicated repository. The research paper was published on arXiv (2508.00757) in August 2025.

## Search Results Summary

The web searches returned information about related but distinct research areas rather than a direct comparison of those two specific approaches:

### Chain-of-Thought (CoT) Prompting
Chain of thought prompting enables models to decompose multi-step problems into intermediate steps, and the accuracy of model responses improves significantly when CoT prompt engineering requires models to explain steps in logical deduction, arithmetic, and multi-step reasoning, including complex reasoning tasks.

### Explanation-First Approaches
Recent research on curriculum learning for knowledge distillation explores structured training: A task-structured curriculum learning (TSCL) framework structures training into three sequential phases: (i) prediction-only, to establish stable feature representations; (ii) joint prediction–explanation, to align task outputs with rationale generation; and (iii) explanation-only, to refine the quality of rationales. Additionally, Because the explanation precedes the decision, accuracy rewards flow back through the explanation tokens that set up correct outcomes.

### Broader Perspective
Research from statistics suggests that predicting and explaining are different, and the causal versus predictive distinction has a large impact on each step of the statistical modeling process.

Unfortunately, I could not locate a specific peer-reviewed study that directly compares "explain then predict" versus "predict then explain" approaches with quantified accuracy metrics on standard NLP benchmarks. If you're looking for research on this specific comparison, you may want to search academic databases like arXiv or look for recent papers on interpretable machine learning and rationale-based reasoning in NLP.

Based on my searches, I was unable to find specific research directly comparing "explain then predict" versus "predict then explain" approaches in NLP with quantified accuracy comparisons. However, the searches did return relevant research on related topics. Let me provide you with what I found:

## Search Results Summary

The web searches returned information about related but distinct research areas rather than a direct comparison of those two specific approaches:

### Chain-of-Thought (CoT) Prompting
Chain of thought prompting enables models to decompose multi-step problems into intermediate steps, and the accuracy of model responses improves significantly when CoT prompt engineering requires models to explain steps in logical deduction, arithmetic, and multi-step reasoning, including complex reasoning tasks.

### Explanation-First Approaches
Recent research on curriculum learning for knowledge distillation explores structured training: A task-structured curriculum learning (TSCL) framework structures training into three sequential phases: (i) prediction-only, to establish stable feature representations; (ii) joint prediction–explanation, to align task outputs with rationale generation; and (iii) explanation-only, to refine the quality of rationales. Additionally, Because the explanation precedes the decision, accuracy rewards flow back through the explanation tokens that set up correct outcomes.

### Broader Perspective
Research from statistics suggests that predicting and explaining are different, and the causal versus predictive distinction has a large impact on each step of the statistical modeling process.

Unfortunately, I could not locate a specific peer-reviewed study that directly compares "explain then predict" versus "predict then explain" approaches with quantified accuracy metrics on standard NLP benchmarks. If you're looking for research on this specific comparison, you may want to search academic databases like arXiv or look for recent papers on interpretable machine learning and rationale-based reasoning in NLP.

    role: key_baseline
    key_finding: >
      Naive GRPO 存在 entropy collapse（policy 熵快速下降→输出同质化）。
      根因：clipping 不对称性——概率 0.01 的 token 最多增到 0.012，而概率 0.9 的 token 可达 1.08，
      低概率 token 难以增长，抑制探索。DAPO 提出 Clip-Higher（εhigh=0.28 > εlow=0.2）
      为低概率 token 留更大增长空间，加 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0 或 1 的 prompt
      （这些 prompt 产生零梯度，降低有效 batch size）。在 AIME 2024 达 50 分超越 DeepSeek-R1-Zero。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DAPO 从 optimization 技巧角度解决 entropy collapse。CED reward 从 reward design 层面
      防止 mode collapse——evidence quality 维度确保 reward 组内有足够 variance，
      不会出现 all-same-reward 的零梯度 prompt。DAPO 的 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0/1 prompt
      与我们观察到的 frac_zero_std→0.8 现象本质相同：extraction-only reward 下大量 prompt
      产生零 advantage，CED 从源头（reward 设计）而非后处理（过滤）解决这个问题。

  - title: "Dr. GRPO: Removing Optimization Bias in GRPO"
    authors: Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: COLM 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20783
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 std 归一化引入两个 bias：(1) difficulty bias——std(r) 归一化对低 variance 组
      （全对/全错）给予过高 advantage 权重，trivial question 主导训练信号；
      (2) length bias——per-token loss 的 1/|o_i| 项使长的错误回答被 under-penalize。
      当 std(r)→0 时 advantage 爆炸或未定义，梯度数值不稳定。
      Dr. GRPO 移除 std 归一化，用无偏 Monte Carlo advantage：Ã = R(q,o_i) - mean(R)。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      与我们的实验发现高度一致：extraction-only reward 下 frac_zero_std→0.8 正是
      Dr. GRPO 分析的 difficulty bias 极端情况——大量 prompt 的所有 rollout 得到相同 F1，
      std→0 导致 advantage 异常。CED 通过增加 reward 维度天然维持 reward_std>0，
      从 reward 设计而非算法修改角度避免了 Dr. GRPO 发现的 bias。

  - title: "A Minimalist Approach to LLM Reasoning: from Rejection Sampling to Reinforce"
    authors: Xiao et al.

    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.11343
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: key_theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RAFT（简单 rejection sampling baseline）在数学推理上与 GRPO/PPO 表现相当。

# Evidence Cost Literature Scan
**Date**: 2026-05-16
**Objective**: 搜索 "evidence generation cost in information extraction" 相关文献，评估 FREIGE 发现的新颖性。

## FREIGE 的核心发现
- No-evidence SFT: rel_f1 = 0.4876
- Evidence SFT: rel_f1 = 0.4106
- **Evidence tax**: -7.7 F1 points (generative SFT, DocRE, LLM fine-tuning)

## 搜索结论

### 新颖性评估: **高度新颖**

**没有任何现有工作在以下组合条件下量化过 evidence 对主任务的性能代价：**
1. Generative (seq2seq) evidence 生成（非 extractive attention supervision）
2. Document-level relation extraction（非 sentence-level）
3. LLM SFT fine-tuning（非 prompting）
4. 明确量化 evidence 导致的 rel_f1 下降

### 与现有工作的关键区别

| 工作 | 设定 | Evidence 对 RE 的影响 | 与 FREIGE 的差异 |
|------|------|---------------------|-----------------|
| DREEAM (Ma+, EACL 2023) | Encoder-based, attention supervision | **帮助** RE (+2 F1) | 非生成式；evidence 是 attention 监督信号 |
| E2GRE (Huang+, 2021) | Encoder-based, joint prediction | **帮助** RE | 非生成式；evidence 是 auxiliary classification head |
| Two Flints (Tang & Surdeanu, CL 2023) | Extractive rationale + RE classification | **帮助** RE (+4% F1) | Sentence-level；extractive 非 generative |
| Resck+ (NAACL 2024 Findings) | Text classification + rationale plausibility | **微弱影响** (negligible) | Classification 非 extraction；非 seq2seq |
| Mind Your Step (Geng+, 2024/ICML 2025) | CoT prompting | **有害** (up to -36.3%) | Prompting 非 SFT；非 IE task |
| CoT-ER (EMNLP 2023 Findings) | Few-shot prompting with evidence for RE | **帮助** RE | Prompting 非 SFT；sentence-level |
| Rationalization Survey (Gurrapu+, 2023) | Survey | 列为 desiderata: "should not hurt" | 仅声明不应有害，未量化 |

### 核心洞察

**Encoder-based discriminative 模型**中，evidence 作为 attention supervision 或 auxiliary task 通常**帮助** RE（DREEAM、E2GRE、CDER、Two Flints）。这是因为 evidence 信号引导模型聚焦相关 context，属于 implicit knowledge injection。

**Generative LLM SFT** 中，要求模型同时生成 evidence 和 relation 是一个**更困难的任务**——模型必须在有限的 output capacity 中分配 token budget 给两个子任务。FREIGE 的 -7.7 F1 量化了这个 "faithfulness tax"，这在文献中是首次。

## 找到的新论文（需加入 literature_map.yaml）

### 1. It Takes Two Flints to Make a Fire (Direct Competitor)
- **Authors**: Zheng Tang, Mihai Surdeanu
- **Year**: 2023
- **Venue**: Computational Linguistics, Vol. 49, Issue 1
- **URL**: https://aclanthology.org/2023.cl-1.3/
- **Key Finding**: Joint training of RE classifier + explanation sequence labeler. Joint training HELPS RE (+~4% F1 on CoNLL04). Explanation classifier operates on extractive features.
- **Role**: direct_competitor
- **Critical Difference**: Sentence-level, extractive, discriminative model. 与 FREIGE 的 generative DocRE 设定相反——他们发现 joint 有益，我们发现 joint 有害。这个对比强化了我们的 contribution。

### 2. Robust Explanation for Free or At the Cost of Faithfulness
- **Authors**: Zeren Tan, Yang Tian
- **Year**: 2023
- **Venue**: ICML 2023
- **URL**: https://proceedings.mlr.press/v202/tan23a.html
- **Key Finding**: 首次理论证明 robustness-faithfulness trade-off 存在。Robust model 可免费获得 robust explanation；non-robust model 提升 explanation robustness 需牺牲 faithfulness。
- **Role**: theoretical_foundation
- **Relevance**: 提供了 "faithfulness 有代价" 的理论框架，虽然研究对象是 post-hoc explanation 而非 generative evidence。

### 3. Rationalization for Explainable NLP: A Survey
- **Authors**: Sai Gurrapu et al.
- **Year**: 2023
- **Venue**: Frontiers in AI
- **URL**: https://www.frontiersin.org/articles/10.3389/frai.2023.1225093/full
- **Key Finding**: 首个 NLP rationalization 综述。列出 desiderata: "rationale extraction should not hurt task performance"。将 rationalization 分为 extractive 和 abstractive 两类。
- **Role**: background_survey
- **Relevance**: 明确了 "不应损害主任务" 是学界共识/期望，但没有论文系统量化违反这一 desiderata 的程度。FREIGE 的发现直接挑战了这一假设。

### 4. Chain of Thought with Explicit Evidence Reasoning for Few-shot RE (CoT-ER)
- **Authors**: Xilai Yin et al.
- **Year**: 2023
- **Venue**: EMNLP 2023 Findings
- **URL**: https://aclanthology.org/2023.findings-emnlp.153/
- **Key Finding**: 用 LLM 先生成 evidence，再 CoT 推理做 few-shot RE。与 fully-supervised SOTA 竞争力相当（FewRel 1.0/2.0）。
- **Role**: related_method
- **Relevance**: 在 prompting 设定下 evidence+CoT 有益。与 SFT 设定下 evidence 有害形成对比——说明 evidence cost 可能是 SFT 训练 specific 的问题。

### 5. Entity and Evidence Guided Relation Extraction for DocRED (E2GRE)
- **Authors**: Kevin Huang et al.
- **Year**: 2021
- **Venue**: RepL4NLP @ ACL 2021
- **URL**: https://aclanthology.org/2021.repl4nlp-1.30/
- **Key Finding**: Joint evidence prediction + relation extraction for DocRED。利用 pretrained LM attention 作为 evidence 特征，joint training 在 RE 和 evidence prediction 上均有增益。
- **Role**: direct_competitor
- **Relevance**: DocRE 上 joint evidence+RE 的先驱。但使用 encoder-based discriminative 模型，evidence 是 binary classification 而非 text generation。他们发现 joint 有益，与 FREIGE 相反。

### 6. Revisiting Relation Extraction in the era of Large Language Models
- **Authors**: Somin Wadhwa, Silvio Amir, Byron Wallace
- **Year**: 2023
- **Venue**: ACL 2023
- **URL**: https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-long.868/
- **Key Finding**: GPT-3 few-shot 在 RE 上接近 SOTA。Seq2seq 大模型在 RE 上有竞争力但评估需要 human evaluation（exact match 低估性能）。
- **Role**: background
- **Relevance**: 建立了 LLM-based generative RE 的 baseline context。

## 总结

| 结论 | 详情 |
|------|------|
| 直接竞品 | **无**——没有论文在 generative SFT + DocRE 设定下量化 evidence cost |
| 间接对比 | Two Flints (sentence-level, extractive → 有益), E2GRE (encoder-based → 有益), CoT-ER (prompting → 有益) |
| 理论支撑 | Tan & Tian ICML 2023 (faithfulness 有理论代价), Rationalization Survey (desiderata: 不应有害) |
| 新颖性确认 | FREIGE 首次在 generative SFT DocRE 中量化 evidence tax (-7.7 F1) |
| Framing 建议 | "文献中 evidence 通常被认为有益（DREEAM, E2GRE, Two Flints）或至少无害（Rationalization Survey desiderata）。FREIGE 揭示了一个被忽视的现象：在 generative LLM SFT 中，faithfulness 有可量化的代价。" |

      当前最佳模型 faithfulness 得分 ~0.88，说明 grounding 仍是显著挑战。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      FACTS Grounding 是 faithfulness 评估的重要 benchmark，验证了 FREIGE 的核心前提：
      即使最强 LLM 在 grounding 任务上也远未完美（~12% failure rate），
      这证明 evidence-grounded IE 中 faithfulness 约束确实会带来 performance cost (C1)。

  - title: "It Takes Two Flints to Make a Fire: Multitask Learning of Neural Relation and Explanation Classifiers"
    authors: Zheng Tang, Mihai Surdeanu
    year: 2023
    venue: Computational Linguistics, Vol. 49, Issue 1
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2023.cl-1.3/
    category: evidence_cost_generative_ie
    role: direct_competitor
    key_finding: >
      Joint training of relation classifier + explanation sequence labeler (extractive rationale)。
      Joint training 不仅不损害 RE，反而提升 ~4% F1 on CoNLL04。
      Explanation classifier 操作在 extractive features 上，保证 faithfulness。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      最直接的对比论文。与 FREIGE 形成关键对照：
      Two Flints 在 sentence-level extractive discriminative 设定下发现 joint evidence+RE 有益；
      FREIGE 在 document-level generative SFT 设定下发现 joint evidence+RE 有害 (-7.7 F1)。
      这个差异揭示了 generative vs discriminative、sentence vs document level 的关键区别。

  - title: "Robust Explanation for Free or At the Cost of Faithfulness"
    authors: Zeren Tan, Yang Tian
    year: 2023
    venue: ICML 2023
    url: https://proceedings.mlr.press/v202/tan23a.html
    category: evidence_cost_generative_ie
    role: theoretical_foundation
    key_finding: >
      首次理论证明 robustness-faithfulness trade-off 存在。
      Robust model 可免费获得 robust explanation；non-robust model 提升 explanation robustness
      需牺牲 faithfulness。对 SmoothGrad 等 6 种方法验证了该 trade-off。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      提供 "faithfulness 有代价" 的理论框架。虽然研究 post-hoc explanation 而非 generative evidence，
      但核心洞察一致：追求可解释性/忠实性可能需要牺牲其他性能维度。
      FREIGE 的 evidence tax 是这一理论在 generative IE 中的实证体现。

  - title: "Rationalization for Explainable NLP: A Survey"
    authors: Sai Gurrapu et al.
    year: 2023
    venue: Frontiers in AI
    url: https://www.frontiersin.org/articles/10.3389/frai.2023.1225093/full
    category: evidence_cost_generative_ie
    role: background_survey
    key_finding: >
      首个 NLP rationalization 综述。列出 desiderata: "rationale extraction should not hurt task performance"。
      将 rationalization 分为 extractive 和 abstractive 两类，覆盖 2007-2023 文献。
      识别了 attention-based rationale 中 noisy rationale 和 prediction accuracy 之间的 trade-off。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      明确了 "不应损害主任务" 是学界共识 desiderata。但没有论文系统量化违反这一 desiderata 的程度。
      FREIGE 的 -7.7 F1 evidence tax 直接挑战了这一假设，证明在 generative SFT 中该 desiderata 不成立。

  - title: "Chain of Thought with Explicit Evidence Reasoning for Few-shot Relation Extraction"
    authors: Xilai Yin et al.
    year: 2023
    venue: EMNLP 2023 Findings
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2023.findings-emnlp.153/
    category: evidence_cost_generative_ie
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      CoT-ER: 用 LLM 先生成 task-specific evidence，再 CoT 推理做 few-shot RE。
      0% training data 下与 fully-supervised SOTA 竞争力相当（FewRel 1.0/2.0）。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      在 prompting 设定下 evidence+CoT 对 RE 有益。
      与 FREIGE SFT 设定下 evidence 有害形成对比——说明 evidence cost 可能是
      SFT 训练 specific 的问题（output format 约束 vs prompting 引导）。

  - title: "Entity and Evidence Guided Relation Extraction for DocRED"
    authors: Kevin Huang et al.
    year: 2021
    venue: RepL4NLP @ ACL 2021
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2021.repl4nlp-1.30/
    category: evidence_cost_generative_ie
    role: direct_competitor
    key_finding: >
      E2GRE: DocRE 上首个 joint evidence prediction + relation extraction 框架。
      利用 entity-guided input 和 pretrained LM attention 作为 evidence 特征。
      Joint training 在 RE 和 evidence prediction 上均有增益，达到 DocRED leaderboard SOTA。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      DocRE 上 joint evidence+RE 的先驱工作。但使用 encoder-based discriminative 模型，
      evidence 是 binary sentence classification（非 text generation）。
      他们发现 joint 有益，与 FREIGE generative 设定下的发现相反——
      核心区别在于 discriminative attention supervision vs generative output format constraint。

  - title: "Revisiting Relation Extraction in the era of Large Language Models"
    authors: Somin Wadhwa, Silvio Amir, Byron Wallace
    year: 2023
    venue: ACL 2023
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-long.868/
    category: evidence_cost_generative_ie
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      系统评估 GPT-3 和 Flan-T5 在标准 RE 任务上的表现。
      Few-shot GPT-3 接近 SOTA，但 exact match 低估 generative RE 性能，需 human evaluation。
      建立了 LLM-based generative RE 的 evaluation methodology。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      建立了 LLM generative RE 的 baseline context，验证了 seq2seq RE 的可行性。
      FREIGE 在此基础上进一步探索了加入 evidence 生成后的性能变化。
